The '''brillibab tree''' was a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It produced a fuzzy fungus that was said to make fires burn more brightly. In preparation for one [[Festival of the Wisties]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] retrieved some of the tree fungus for the shaman [[Logray/Legends|Logray]].
